articles.title: GTA 6 Releases at Midnight Local Time on 19 November 2026
articles.summary: GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time on Thursday 19 November 2026, in every region, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

articles.title: The GTA 6 Pre-Load Needs Up to 212 GB
articles.summary: Rockstar says the GTA 6 pre-load needs up to 212 GB of free space, depending on your console.

articles.title: Physical Copies of GTA 6 Have No Disc
articles.summary: The physical version of GTA 6 is a download code in a box. There's no disc and no physical Ultimate Edition.

articles.title: Buy GTA 6 Before 20 November to Get the Vintage Vice City Pack
articles.summary: Pre-orders and purchases of GTA 6 before 20 November 2026 include the Vintage Vice City Pack, on either edition.

articles.title: GTA 6 Targets 30 FPS, With Extra Visuals on PS5 Pro
articles.summary: GTA 6 targets 30 fps on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. PS5 Pro adds PSSR image quality and ray-traced shadows.

articles.title: GTA 6 Supports Xbox Cloud Gaming and Remote Play
articles.summary: GTA 6 is playable through Xbox Cloud Gaming, including on Xbox One, and supports Remote Play on PlayStation and Xbox.

articles.title: Six GTA 6 Radio Stations Revealed So Far
articles.summary: Rockstar has named six GTA 6 radio stations: Cocoteo FM, Back Country Radio, AfroBank FM, The Chamber 106.6, Flash FM and Dirty South Classics.

articles.title: GTA 6's Original Score Is by Justice
articles.summary: French duo Justice composed GTA 6's adaptive score. A 30-track score album follows on 11 December 2026.

articles.title: A Free GTA 6 Poster and Map of Leonida Arrive on Launch Day
articles.summary: On 19 November 2026, Rockstar adds a free printable GTA 6 cover poster and map of Leonida to the official site.

articles.title: GTA 6 Stars Jason and Lucia in the State of Leonida
articles.summary: GTA 6 follows Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos in the fictional state of Leonida, home to a modern-day Vice City.

articles.title: How Radio and Podcasts Work in GTA 6
articles.summary: GTA 6 radio works on foot through headphones on your phone, and the game adds on-demand podcasts for the first time.

articles.title: GTA 6's Adaptive Score by Justice Explained
articles.summary: GTA 6's score by Justice adapts to how you play. Here's what Rockstar has confirmed, and what it hasn't yet.

articles.title: How Ultimate Edition Items Unlock in GTA 6
articles.summary: GTA 6's Ultimate Edition items are spread across the story's chapters, and Standard owners can upgrade at any time.

articles.title: GTA 6 on PS5 and PS5 Pro: Haptics, 3D Audio and Graphics Explained
articles.summary: GTA 6 targets 30 fps. PS5 adds adjustable haptics and 3D audio; PS5 Pro adds PSSR and ray-traced shadows.

articles.title: GTA 6 Cloud Gaming and Remote Play Explained
articles.summary: Play GTA 6 through Xbox Cloud Gaming, including on Xbox One, or stream from your own console with Remote Play.

articles.title: The State of Leonida Explained: GTA 6's Regions So Far
articles.summary: GTA 6 is set in Leonida. Rockstar has shown six areas so far: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga.

articles.title: How to Pre-Load GTA 6 Automatically Before Launch
articles.summary: Turn on auto-downloads and leave your console in rest or sleep mode, so GTA 6 is ready at midnight.

articles.title: How to Make Room for GTA 6's 212 GB Pre-Load
articles.summary: Free up at least 212 GB before pre-loading GTA 6, plus some headroom for day-one updates.

articles.title: How to Find GTA 6's Haptics and Accessibility Options
articles.summary: Open GTA 6's accessibility settings first: Rockstar says PS5 haptic feedback can be adjusted there.

articles.title: How to Set Up Your Screen and Sound Before Playing GTA 6
articles.summary: Calibrate brightness, turn on game mode and use headphones for 3D audio before your first GTA 6 session.

articles.title: How to Avoid Losing Progress in GTA 6 With Good Saving Habits
articles.summary: Don't rely on autosave alone: save manually before big jobs, keep a second slot and never quit while saving.
